summary: Writes a length-prefixed string a1 into a buffered stream object a2 under a critical section. Measures the string, locks the stream buffer, fetches a flag/handle from the stream via sub_58E41B, writes the bytes with sub_5886A7, clears stream fields when the flag is set, releases the critical section, and returns 0 when every byte was written or -1 otherwise.

operations.description: Measure the input string length with Strlen(a1).
Lock the stream buffer via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection(a2).
Fetch a per-stream value v3 from sub_58E41B(a2) used to decide field clearing.
Write v2 bytes of a1 into the stream via sub_5886A7(a1, 1u, v2, a2); store the number of bytes actually written in v5.
Clear stream struct fields if the fetched flag is set via ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet(v3, a2).
Release the buffer critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a2).
Return (v5 == v2) - 1: 0 when the full length was written, -1 otherwise.

clean_pseudocode: unsigned int written = sub_5886A7(text, 1u, len, stream);
unresolved: Exact contract of stream object a2 and of the sub_5886A7 write primitive (buffered vs unbuffered, error handling).
Semantics of the sub_58E41B return value consumed by ClearStructFieldsIfFlagSet.
